title: Nothing script-side can make a keeper fight in Icky Cave (27)
text:
Three combat paths were measured against room 27 with 8 orcs in the room and a level-58 body at full health. NONE of them landed a blow.
1. The BROKER's `fight` tool is dead on a keeper-backed character. Four minutes, body never moved, combat never went active, and the call eventually failed outright. It answers the trivial case ("nothing here matches orc") from its snapshot, which makes it look alive.
2. The KEEPER's `fight` action is a no-op that reports success: `await session.fight?.(args.target,args)` then `json(r ?? {ok:true})`, and `session.fight` is not defined ANYWHERE in the tree. It returns {ok:true} having done nothing.
3. Handing the body back to the keeper's own hunter does not help HERE. With hunt=[orc,spider], roam:false, assigned_room:27 the character shuffled between r25c29 and r25c31 for 4.5 minutes, combat never active, 8 orcs present, zero teeth.
The only primitive that reaches the wire is the keeper's `attack_rounds`, which swung 10 times and got 10 server replies. It needs a target_id and it needs the body already in reach: at d=3 every swing came back 'The orc is too far away to hit with a mace.' `approach` is NOT a general keeper action - it is an RTS context intent needing control/lease tokens.
So: an errand that says 'go to 27 and kill an orc' will complete every leg and kill nothing, and act('fight') reports ok because it only checks for an `error` field.
evidence: 2026-09-16 shadow fleet, Llll (shadow12, lvl 58, 53/53hp) teleported into 27. Broker fight: 8 polls x 30s, r25c31 throughout, combat=false, pack unchanged. attack_rounds on orc 7099 at d=3: 10x 'too far away to hit with a mace'. Keeper hunt with pull_to_safe_wall:false: useSafeSpots coerced back to true, shuffle r25c29-31, 0 kills in 4.5 min.

Same failure as 750, 35 and 828: a body crossing "A Deep, Dark, Spooky, Icky Cave" (27) wedges and cannot close on a quarry. walk_fine slides and returns arrived:false reason:'ran out of steps' from the same square, with geometry_rejections:['geometry_blocked'], and the gap to the target stops shrinking at 8 squares.
The COMBAT half of the old note here is fixed and this supersedes it: the keeper's fight action was a no-op that returned {ok:true} because session.fight does not exist. It now closes then swings and reports engaged/closed/killed separately, so 'could not get there' and 'got there and missed' are distinguishable. Placed one square from an orc it engages, kills, and the teeth land in the pack.
evidence: 2026-09-16, Llll (lvl 58) in 27. Wedged at r27c19: fight returns engaged:false closed:false distance:8 'could not close'. Teleported to r28c56 beside orc 7100: fight 1 engaged, 16 swings, real hit/dodge messages; fight 2 killed:true in 4 swings; pack gained orc toothx3.
